It is further submitted that prosecutrix is major and is a married woman.
In these circumstances, applicant may be granted anticipatory bail.
3. Learned Govt. Advocate appearing for State as well as counsel for Objector opposed the application for grant of anticipatory bail and relied on statement of prosecutrix.
4. Heard the learned counsel for the parties 5.
After incident, prosecutrix has not reported the matter to police.
She continued to have relationship with applicant for sometime and after a long delay, FIR has been filed at Police Station.
6. Considering aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, anticipatory bail application filed by the applicant is allowed.

It is directed that in the event of arrest of applicant in connection with the aforesaid crime number and the offences, he be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rs. Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Investigating Officer/Arresting Authority.
7. The applicant is directed to join the investigation immediately and to co-operate with the investigating agency.

He will further abide by the condition enumerated in sub-section (2) of Section 438 of the Cr.P.C.
